description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimulus types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into 9 slices, each representing a distinct stimulus type. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages. The largest slice, "Draft/Other", is colored red and accounts for 26% of the total, while "Press Release" and "External News Article" are the second and third largest, colored yellow and green, and representing 18.7% and 18.1%, respectively. The remaining slices, in descending order of size, are "Interview" (8.8%, purple), "Organizational Report" (7.7%, pink), "Event Posting" (6.6%, blue), "Organizational Website" (4.9%, light blue), "Email" (2.7%, light green), and "Social Media Post" (1.1%, dark yellow). The chart includes percentage labels for each slice, but does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way beyond their size.
